hero.title: Know Where You Stand. Know What Must Change. Know What to Do Next.
hero.description:
TNI²TRI 2026 brings industrial intelligence, transformation-readiness assessment and structured implementation into one continuous framework.

It helps industries understand their current capabilities, identify critical gaps and dependencies, determine transformation readiness, prioritise what matters most, and establish a practical direction for the next stage of growth and transformation.

highlightWidgets.title: INDUSTRIAL INTELLIGENCE
highlightWidgets.headline: Understand what is happening.
highlightWidgets.description: Industrial intelligence creates the context required to understand the organisation and its environment.

highlightWidgets.title: TRANSFORMATION READINESS
highlightWidgets.headline: Understand where you stand and what you are ready for.
highlightWidgets.description: Assess capability, maturity, gaps, risks, dependencies and transformation readiness.

highlightWidgets.title: TRANSFORMATION
highlightWidgets.headline: Know what to do next.
highlightWidgets.description: Connect intelligence and readiness with priorities, resources, planning, transformation and measurable outcomes.

challengeSection.heading: Transformation Should Not Begin With Investment. It Should Begin With Understanding.
paragraphs: Industries today operate within rapidly changing markets, technologies, customer expectations, supply networks, regulations, skills, financial conditions and competitive environments.
Yet many transformation decisions begin with a solution before the organisation has fully understood the problem.

newWay.title: The TNI²TRI Approach
newWay.primaryQuestion: What does the organisation actually need?

challengeSection.highlightStatement: Understand before you transform. Transform with direction. Learn and evolve continuously.

systemSection.title: Three Connected Layers. One Transformation Journey.
systemSection.subtitle: INTELLIGENCE → READINESS → TRANSFORMATION

layers.title: Industrial Intelligence
layers.question: What is happening?
layers.desc: Establishes holistic situational context, macro/sectoral trends, supply dynamics, and market benchmarks.

layers.title: Transformation Readiness Intelligence
layers.question: Where are we now, and what are we ready for?
layers.desc: Evaluates organizational capabilities across 10 domains, surfacing verified evidence, gaps, and readiness ratings.

layers.title: Transformation Intelligence & Implementation
layers.question: What should we do next, and how should we transform?
layers.desc: Synthesizes diagnostic insights into prioritized action roadmaps, resource allocation, and continuous measurement loops.

adaptiveAssessmentWidget.title: Not a Long Questionnaire.
adaptiveAssessmentWidget.subtitle: An Adaptive Diagnostic Process.
adaptiveAssessmentWidget.description: TNI²TRI does not require every organisation to answer the same long questionnaire. The assessment progressively adapts according to the organisation's context and responses.
adaptiveAssessmentWidget.highlight: The objective is not to ask more questions. The objective is to ask the right questions.

evidenceWidget.title: From Answers to Evidence-Based Understanding
evidenceWidget.description: TNI²TRI distinguishes between what an organisation reports and what available evidence demonstrates.

levels.title: Unverified
levels.desc: Self-reported information without sufficient supporting evidence.

levels.title: Corroborated
levels.desc: Multiple sources or evidence support the finding.

diagnosisSection.title: A Weakness Is Not Yet a Diagnosis
diagnosisSection.description: TNI²TRI goes beyond identifying a low score.

flow.desc: Distance between actual performance and standard
Quantified risk to enterprise output and scale

diagnosisSection.highlightStatement: We do not stop at identifying what is wrong. We seek to understand why it is happening and what should happen next.

readinessSection.title: Are You Ready to Transform?
readinessSection.subtitle: Transformation readiness is not simply: Ready / Not Ready

scale.label: Not Ready
scale.desc: Absence of prerequisite clarity, governance or basic resources.

scale.label: Aware
scale.desc: Recognition of transformation need, but initial planning unformed.

scale.label: Preparing
scale.desc: Structuring requirements, resources, and baseline alignments.

scale.label: Ready
scale.desc: Capabilities and resources mobilized for phased execution.

scale.label: Transformation Ready
scale.desc: Mature alignment, validated evidence, and agile change control.

scale.label: Transformation Capable
scale.desc: Institutionalized agility, continuous learning, and self-renewal.

prioritySection.title: Not Everything Needs to Change at Once.
prioritySection.description: TNI²TRI helps distinguish: What is weak from What matters most right now.

chain.question: How will the new capability operate?

transformationControlSection.title: Know When to Continue. Know When to Stop.
transformationControlSection.subtitle: Transformation requires decision discipline.

decisions.name: MODIFY
decisions.desc: The direction remains valid, but the approach needs adjustment.

decisions.name: RESET
decisions.desc: The underlying assumptions need to be reconsidered.
